faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: A quick guide to SPACE8
faq.faq_booking_q: How do I book a table?
faq.faq_booking_a: Choose a date, time slot, and duration, then pay right away by credit card or another electronic method. Your QR code arrives instantly. No staff needed.
faq.faq_entry_q: How do I get in after I book?
faq.faq_entry_a: Once your payment is confirmed, you get your own QR code. Scan it at the door sensor when you arrive and the door opens. It's all self-service.
faq.faq_cancel_q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.faq_cancel_a: Once a booking is confirmed, it can't be cancelled, rescheduled, or refunded. The exception is Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above, or a Black Rainstorm Warning, when you can ask to reschedule. For details, see the Venue Rules and Terms, [Section 3](/legal?doc=terms#section-3) and [Section 6](/legal?doc=terms#section-6).
faq.faq_hours_a: SPACE8 is open every day from 06:00 to 24:00, all year, including public holidays.
faq.faq_smoking_q: Can I smoke in the room?
faq.faq_smoking_a: No. The whole venue is smoke-free, including cigarettes, e-cigarettes and heated tobacco, so the air stays clean for everyone. If you need to smoke, head outside the building.
faq.faq_weather_a:
【Typhoon Signal 8 or above, or Black Rainstorm Warning】
We stay open. The venue's automated systems keep running as usual. Decide for yourself whether it's safe to come.
Rescheduling: If you can't come, message us on WhatsApp before your booking starts. We'll reschedule you for free within 7 days. Refunds aren't available.
Late requests: If you ask after your booking has started, or don't use the session within 7 days, the booking is forfeited.

【Any other weather, such as Typhoon Signal 3 or an Amber or Red Rainstorm Warning】
No changes: Apart from the extreme weather policy above, confirmed bookings can't be cancelled, rescheduled, or refunded.
faq.faq_overtime_q: What if I go over my time?
faq.faq_overtime_a: If nobody is booked after you, leave within 10 minutes. If you keep using the facilities after 10 minutes, a full 1-hour rental charge applies. If the next slot is booked, the screen in your room gently reminds you 5 minutes before your session ends. Tidy up and head out before your time is up.
faq.faq_pricing_a: Prices are per hour and depend on the time slot. Book 2 or more hours in a row and you save. Going over your time costs extra. For details, see the [Pricing page](/pricing) and the Venue Rules and Terms, [Section 3](/legal?doc=terms#section-3).
faq.faq_points_a: Earn 1 point for every HK$1 you spend. As your points grow, you move up to Premier and Prestige, with more benefits. For details, see the [Membership page](/membership).
faq.faq_facilities_a: A professional pool table, quality standard cues, premium lighting, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and a self-serve water station.
faq.faq_guests_a: Yes. Each session fits several players, and the price covers everyone. There's no extra charge per person.
faq.faq_contact_a: Message us on WhatsApp or email info@space8.com.hk. We'll reply as soon as we can.
faq.faq_sanpokong_q: Where can I play Chinese pool in San Po Kong?
faq.faq_sanpokong_a: SPACE8 is at Room 05, 3/F, Laurels Industrial Centre, 32 Tai Yau Street, San Po Kong, Hong Kong. It's a self-service, smoke-free Chinese pool venue with two private rooms, one table each. Booking is required. It's near Diamond Hill and Kai Tak MTR stations.
faq.faq_location_q: Where is SPACE8, and how do I get there?
faq.faq_location_a: Address: Room 05, 3/F, Laurels Industrial Centre, 32 Tai Yau Street, San Po Kong, Hong Kong. It's an 8 to 10 minute walk from Diamond Hill MTR station (Exit A2) or Kai Tak MTR station (Airside, Exit C). The recommended route from Diamond Hill Exit A2 is about 500 m. You can also take a bus or minibus to Tai Yau Street. If you're driving, we suggest the New Tech Plaza car park (Wilson Parking).
faq.faq_how_to_book_q: How do I book and get in?
faq.faq_how_to_book_a: SPACE8 is by reservation only, and you'll need a member account to book. Choose a date, time slot, and duration online, then pay. Your QR code is emailed to you and also appears under My Bookings in your account. When you arrive, scan it at the entrance to go in.
faq.faq_private_room_q: Is there one table per room?
faq.faq_private_room_a: Yes. SPACE8 has two private rooms, and each has a single Chinese pool table. Close the door and it's just you and your group. Nothing is shared.
faq.faq_strangers_q: Will strangers walk in while I play?
faq.faq_strangers_a: No. During your session, the whole room is yours alone, and entry is by QR code. Nobody else can come in.
faq.faq_vs_traditional_q: How is SPACE8 different from a traditional pool hall?
faq.faq_vs_traditional_a: Traditional pool halls are usually open halls with many tables and mixed crowds. SPACE8 is by reservation only, with one table per room, self-service and smoke-free. Book online, scan in, and play in your own room. No queues. No strangers.

memberHelp.faq_cancel_q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
memberHelp.faq_cancel_a: Once a booking is confirmed and paid, there are no cancellations, reschedules or refunds. The exceptions: (1) the payment didn't go through or failed; (2) weather (Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above, or a Black Rainstorm Warning); (3) the cause lies with us (facility failure, a duplicate charge by our system, or cancellation by us).
memberHelp.faq_paid_missing_q: I paid but can't see my booking. Why?
memberHelp.faq_paid_missing_a: A booking with incomplete payment isn't treated as confirmed. If you think you were charged but the system doesn't show success, contact us on WhatsApp (+852 6180 8022) or at Info@space8.com.hk with your proof of payment.
memberHelp.faq_weather_q: What happens in a typhoon or heavy rain?
memberHelp.faq_weather_a: When the Observatory issues Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above or a Black Rainstorm Warning, members must request a reschedule on the official WhatsApp before the booked session starts. You can then rebook a session of equal value within 7 days of the original date. No cash or original-method refund applies in this case. Only rescheduling is offered.
memberHelp.faq_refund_time_q: When will I get my refund?
memberHelp.faq_refund_time_a: Refunds always go back to the original payment method. There are no cash refunds. We submit the refund instruction within 3 working days of verification. Banks and e-wallets typically take 5-14 working days to credit it, which is outside our control.
memberHelp.faq_facility_q: Can I get a refund if equipment is broken?
memberHelp.faq_facility_a: If the cause lies with us (facility failure, a duplicate charge by our system, or cancellation by us), you can choose a make-up session or a full refund to the original payment method.
memberHelp.faq_refund_status_q: How do I check my refund status?
memberHelp.faq_refund_status_a: Contact us on WhatsApp (+852 6180 8022) or at Info@space8.com.hk with your order number (format: SPACE8-XXXXX-C).
